tei:div.tei:p: You existed before the world was created. You exist [in the same way] now that the world has been created. You exist in this world, and You will exist in the World-to-Come. Sanctify Your Name upon those who hallow Your Name, and sanctify Your Name in Your world. And through Your deliverance You will be exalted and You will uplift our power. Blessed are you Adonoy who sanctifies His Name among the multitudes.

tei:note.tei:p: According to other versions, the text is translated, “You will be exalted,” since the Hebrew reads תָּרוּם.
